descriptions.d24i_trigger_zone_update_80125934: Trigger zone update: starts the object iterator at +100 and walks it until the 0xffff terminator or until flag +76, +80 or +88 is set; for each current object from another team dispatches by object type to worm entered (1), the team checks (136 and 8, limited by counts +64 and +68) or the trigger (512 when +84 is set); then finishes the walk and collects when +88 is set.
